root_cause: Composio v3.1 tool-execute request omitted the connected account's user_id. Production read-only SalesRobot probe returned HTTP 400; the API's connected-account inventory provides the correct user_id.

evidence.provider_api_user_id_probes: Both existing active SalesRobot connected accounts returned successful HTTP 200 read-only tool responses when user_id from the same account was supplied

prevention: Never execute a Composio v3.1 tool without exact connected_account_id and user_id bound from the same connection.
Enforce missing user_id fail-closed before provider API call.
Keep independent provider result proof, consent, suppression and anti-duplicate send safeguards.
change: Include user_id in existing Composio execute helper for SalesRobot account probe and any approved outbound DM, with a bounded timeout and sanitized error details. No new provider, sender or scheduler.
verification_required: safe dry_run provider result after deployment
